questions.answer: A relationship through which comfort or protection may be sought.

questions.prompt: Are infant classifications interchangeable with adult dimensions?
Can an ordinary vignette establish a diagnosis?
questions.answer: No; clinical assessment requires appropriate expertise and evidence.
questions.feedback: Avoid testing real children or adults.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Explains attachment functions and research methods and limits inference from ordinary observations.
scoring.transfer: Write a fictional research-literacy critique explaining secure base, safe haven and adult attachment dimensions. Include two rival explanations for a behaviour and a reason not to assign an attachment classification.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
